answer: Watch when identities arrive, not just what they claim. Log each transaction timestamp and inter-arrival gap at ingress; genuine operators show jittered, sleep-cycle rhythms, while a sybil farm emits near-identical deltas from one scheduler. Cluster accounts by that timing fingerprint, then require a distinctive cadence before an address can become a haven for rewards. Missing it, farms flood from a single zenith of activity and slip through the reef of per-account limits.
